pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: big 2-story hip, nearly a pyramid: hips from the NW corner (402,291) and SW corner (405,522) meet a short E-W ridge near y 405 from x about 497 to 548; the east slope runs on past x 590 with no break line down to a low east eave at x 642 (LiDAR eave there about 9 to 12 ft vs 18 ft on the west), so it stays one piece; SE corner hips down to the south eave at y 524 (pale S-facing triangle apex (590,480)); NE corner (590-642, 297-340) is a dark N-facing facet, not flat

pieces.name: north_gable
pieces.notes: N-S ridge at x about 517 running from the north eave (ridge reaches the eave at full height, so gabled north) south to y about 346 where it dies into the main north slope; its west slope meets the main north face in the dark valley from (448,291) to (511,346); dark vertical strip at x 520-540 is the chimney shadow (chimney at 520,360), not a face

pieces.name: sw_wing
pieces.notes: 1-story hip on the south of the main SW: hips from (380,599) and (500,600) meet at (438,545), then a very short N-S ridge dies into the main south wall at y about 522; dark N-facing triangle between (438,545) and the wall

exclude_notes: white scalloped awning and patio cover along the south eave of the main east half; trace overshoots to y 544 there
notes: 2-story hip main with a short E-W ridge, a gabled N-S wing on its north side (west valley), and a 1-story hip wing on the SW. Confidence med-high: the piece split and exclusions are clear; medium on the main ridge direction (nearly a pyramid, LiDAR ridges are short and both N-S and E-W fragments show) and on whether the east slope is one plane to x 642 (no step or wall shadow visible, LiDAR eave height on the east is low).
